sections.title: Critical Writing Seminar in Global Studies: Cairo as Palimpsest
sections.description: The global writing seminar enhances the already immersive pedagogical approach of the current writing seminars by providing students with the opportunity to read, research, discuss, and write about a place-based issue--as well as experience the place firsthand.
